text:
Alex: quick check — noticing ~4% p95 regression on onprem nodes compared to VPC for the same dedicated config. suspect cpufreq/pstate + kernel symlink mismatch across images. anyone around to validate node set?
Priya: which nodes? can run a fast smoke. :eyes:
Alex: node ids: onprem-ny1-13, onprem-ny1-14. benchmark cmd I used:
```bash
./bench --model redwood-4b --seq 1024 --concurrency 2 --runs 20
```
Alex: numbers: ny1-13 p95=42ms, ny1-14 p95=44ms, vpc-equivalent p95=40ms. not huge but consistent across a few runs.
Devon: can you paste uname -r and the cpufreq governor on those? also check /boot/ which kernel symlink is active.
Alex: sure, grabbing now.
Alex: onprem-ny1-13:
```text
uname -r: 5.19.12-rt
cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_governor: performance
ls -l /boot/vmlinuz -> /boot/vmlinuz-5.19.12-rt
```
Alex: onprem-ny1-14:
```text
uname -r: 5.19.12-rt
cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_governor: schedutil
ls -l /boot/vmlinuz -> /boot/vmlinuz-5.19.8
```
Priya: ah — schedutil vs performance could explain micro variance. and different kernel symlink hints at image drift. does infra repo expect a pinned vmlinuz name or symlink management? @infra-bot any recent image flips?
infra-bot: image-deploy pipeline: deploy/2026-02-10 updated kernel packages, image tags: stable-20260210. Some onprem pools still on rolling-202601 stable snapshots.
Devon: thanks. plan: 1) force governor=performance on the two nodes and rerun bench 2) reconcile kernel symlink to point to the same vmlinuz on both nodes, then restart and rerun. can someone do (1) quick? command below.
Devon: run on node:
```bash
for c in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor; do echo performance | sudo tee $c; done
```
Maria: I can run step 1 on ny1-14 now, will post numbers.
Maria: ran governor change and re-ran bench. results ny1-14 p95 dropped to 40.5ms (from 44). small noise but aligns.
Maria: quick perf top output (trimmed):
```text
redwood-runtime  30%  llc-miss hotspots: attention_kernel
python3         18%  memcpy
```
Alex: nice. so cpufreq was major contributor. still want to align kernels — will open infra PR to pin symlink and add a smoke in image-deploy. @Priya can you take the PR review? I’ll include rollback steps.
Priya: yep I'll review. also suggest adding a quick cpufreq sanity check in node-join scripts (set governor) so this doesn't drift.
Devon: +1. I'll add a small checklist and a smoke test in our infra-runbooks.
Alex: thanks all. filing followups: infra PR (#3421), bench run logs attached in ticket, and an ops reminder to verify on other racks. closing this thread for async followups. :+1:
